answer.answer: Three finance-sector programmes combine basic banking, life insurance, and accident insurance as follows: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) provides basic banking through Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts (BSBDA) with no minimum balance requirement [E02]. The Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) offers life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason, with a premium of ₹436 per annum [E01]. The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) provides accident insurance covering accidental death and disability with a premium of ₹20 per annum [E03]. All three schemes are offered through banks and post offices, with premiums auto-debited from account holders' accounts, creating an integrated approach to financial security for account holders aged 18-50 years (or up to 70 for PMSBY).
